description: Machine-readable quality gate consumed by CI and by contributors (human or AI) before opening a PR. See QUALITY.md for the rationale.

excludedFiles.reason: Barrel files, no logic of their own.
drizzle-kit generated SQL, not hand-written/reviewed logic.
One-shot CLI bootstrap script (side-effecting: reads real env, opens a real DB file, calls process.exit). Exercised by running `bun run db:migrate` in CI/deploy, not by unit tests.

Declarative Drizzle table definitions. The one non-declarative bit worth noting: a `.references(() => table.column)` callback is only invoked by drizzle-kit's own introspection, never at runtime, so it can't be exercised by an application-level test.

Process entrypoint (side-effecting: reads real env, opens a real DB file and a real TCP port, calls process.exit). Exercised by running `bun run dev`/`bun run start`, not by unit tests. Its logic (env validation branch, wiring) is duplicated in a testable form by presentation/factories/make-generate-suggestions.ts and presentation/http/server.ts, both of which ARE covered.

rules: Every new/changed feature must ship with tests of the type(s) required for the layer(s) it touches (see requiredTestTypes).
No raw try/catch for fallible operations (LLM calls, DB reads/writes, env parsing) — use better-result (Result/TaggedError/Result.tryPromise/Result.gen). See CLAUDE.md 'Error handling' section.
A file may only be added to coverage.excludedFiles with a stated reason, reviewed like any other quality-gate change.
CI must run `bun run typecheck`, `bun run lint`, and `bun run test:coverage` and block merge on any of them failing.
